name: Combobox
description:
Pick a value (or several) from a list you can filter by typing - Autocomplete's sibling for selection: the value is one of the items, the input reverts to its label when you leave, and it submits under `name:` from hidden inputs.

  Combobox(items: frameworks, name: "framework", default_value: "Astro", clearable: true) do
    ComboboxInput(placeholder: "Search a framework")
    ComboboxContent do
      ComboboxEmpty { "No frameworks found." }
      ComboboxList { |item| ComboboxItem(value: item) { item } }
    end
  end

`multiple: true` with ComboboxChips shows each value as a removable chip. ComboboxTrigger + ComboboxValue make a select-style field with the ComboboxInput inside ComboboxContent. `creatable: true` offers "Create "…"" for a query with no exact match. The chevron (`icon:`) is on by default. Emits `appica-ui--combobox:change` with { value } (an array when multiple) and `appica-ui--combobox:create` with { value } for a created entry.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `Combobox(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

ComboboxChips.description: The field of a `multiple` Combobox: a removable chip per selected value, then the text field for adding more. Backspace in the empty field removes the last chip.

ComboboxContent.description: The Combobox's popup. A ComboboxInput inside it becomes the search field.

ComboboxInput.description: The Combobox's text field (styled like Input): typing filters the list. It shows the selected item's label; inside ComboboxContent it's the popup's search field instead. `start_slot: :selected_icon` mirrors the selected item's `data: { icon: "start" }` element.

ComboboxItem.description: One option of a Combobox, with a check while selected. `value:` is what it submits.

ComboboxTrigger.description: A select-style field for a Combobox whose search input lives inside ComboboxContent. Put ComboboxValue in it. Set `icon: false` on the root so the popup's input has no chevron.

ComboboxValue.description: The selected item's label inside a ComboboxTrigger; `placeholder:` when empty.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  Combobox(variant:, size:, clearable:, icon:, grid:, disabled:, multiple:, creatable:, required:, include_hidden:, **given(value:, default_value:), items: FRAMEWORKS, name:, class: "max-w-70") do
    ComboboxInput(placeholder: "Search a framework", aria_label: "Framework")
    ComboboxContent do
      ComboboxEmpty { "No frameworks found." }
      ComboboxList { |item| ComboboxItem(value: item) { item } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Variants
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex w-full max-w-70 flex-col gap-4") do
    %i[ outline soft ].each do |variant|
      Combobox(items: FRAMEWORKS, variant:) do
        ComboboxInput(placeholder: "Search a framework", aria_label: "Framework (#{variant})")
        ComboboxContent do
          ComboboxEmpty { "No frameworks found." }
          ComboboxList { |item| ComboboxItem(value: item) { item } }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Clearable & chevron
examples.notes: The chevron is on by default (`icon: false` to drop it); `clearable:` adds a ✕.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Combobox(items: FRAMEWORKS, default_value: "Astro", clearable: true, class: "max-w-70") do
    ComboboxInput(placeholder: "Search a framework", aria_label: "Framework")
    ComboboxContent do
      ComboboxEmpty { "No frameworks found." }
      ComboboxList { |item| ComboboxItem(value: item) { item } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Country select
examples.notes:
Object items read through `item_to_string_value:` / `item_to_string_label:`;
`start_slot: :selected_icon` mirrors the chosen flag.
examples.code:
countries = %w[ au at be br ca cz fr de in it jp mx nl pl es se ch gb us ].map { |code| { code:, name: I18n.t("ui_components.countries.#{code}", default: code.upcase) } }
phlex do
  Combobox(items: countries, item_to_string_value: :code, item_to_string_label: :name, default_value: "cz", name: "country", class: "max-w-70") do
    ComboboxInput(placeholder: "Search a country", start_slot: :selected_icon, aria_label: "Country")
    ComboboxContent do
      ComboboxEmpty { "No countries found." }
      ComboboxList(class: "max-h-64") do |country|
        ComboboxItem(value: country[:code], data: { label: country[:name] }) do
          CountryFlag(country[:code], class: "size-4.5 text-base", data: { icon: "start" })
          plain country[:name]
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Input inside the popup
examples.notes: ComboboxTrigger + ComboboxValue make a select-style field; the search lives in the popup.

examples.name: Grouped options
examples.code:
groups = [ { value: "Fruits", items: %w[ Apple Banana Orange ] }, { value: "Vegetables", items: %w[ Carrot Potato Tomato ] } ]
phlex do
  Combobox(items: groups, class: "max-w-70") do
    ComboboxInput(placeholder: "Search food", aria_label: "Food")
    ComboboxContent do
      ComboboxEmpty { "No food found." }
      ComboboxList do |group|
        ComboboxGroup(items: group[:items]) do
          ComboboxLabel { group[:value] }
          ComboboxCollection { |item| ComboboxItem(value: item) { item } }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Multiple selection
examples.notes: ComboboxChips shows each value as a chip; Backspace in the empty field removes the last.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Combobox(items: FRAMEWORKS + %w[ Gatsby Vite ], multiple: true, default_value: [ "Next.js", "Astro" ], name: "frameworks", clearable: true, class: "max-w-70") do
    ComboboxChips(placeholder: "Add frameworks", aria_label: "Frameworks")
    ComboboxContent do
      ComboboxEmpty { "No frameworks found." }
      ComboboxList { |item| ComboboxItem(value: item) { item } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Creatable
examples.notes:
`creatable: true` offers the query as a new entry when nothing matches exactly
(`appica-ui--combobox:create` fires with it).
examples.code:
phlex do
  Combobox(items: [ "bug", "documentation", "enhancement", "help wanted", "good first issue" ], multiple: true, creatable: true, class: "max-w-70") do
    ComboboxChips(placeholder: "Add labels…", aria_label: "Labels")
    ComboboxContent do
      ComboboxEmpty { "No labels found." }
      ComboboxList { |item| ComboboxItem(value: item) { item } }
    end
  end
end

      end

  end
end
